jobs.description:
Do you want to lead a coffee shop where coffee, great service, and community are our focus?

We’re looking for a passionate and dedicated Store Manager to take the lead at one of our coffee shops. At Original Coffee, we serve good coffee – and we believe that good coffee and a good service creates an experience – the Original Coffee experience. So, if you’re passionate about excellent service, good coffee, sustainability, and leadership, this might be the perfect job for you!

Who are we?

Original Coffee is a fast-growing company and therefore we need more talented people to join our team. We have 21 coffee shops based around in Copenhagen and our coffee shops invites our guests to find calm, focus, and connection with themselves and others.

At Original Coffee our mission is to create an experience from the moment our guests step into our coffee shops. The experience, which we call the ‘OC experience’, is defined by our exceptional coffee and great service - key elements we consider equally important.

Your role as Store Manager

As a Store Manager at Original Coffee, you will be responsible for:

• Being an ambassador for our values and fostering a warm and welcoming atmosphere for both our guests and baristas.

• Leading, developing, and motivating the team to perform at their best.

• Overseeing daily operations e.g. inventory management and reduce waste.

• Managing shift planning, vacation plans, and possible changes due to e.g. sickness.

• Hire new baristas, host staff meetings and 1:1with baristas.

• Ensuring and following up on e.g. daily cleaning routines.

• Driving sales initiatives and working on continuous optimization.

We’re looking for someone who…

• Has leadership experience, preferably from the Coffee shop, or the food and beverage industry.

• Is passionate about creating outstanding guest experiences.

• Can maintain an overview also during our fast-paced environment.

• Is an inspiring leader who thrives on lead by example, developing others and building a strong team.

• Pays attention to detail and focuses on both quality and efficiency.

We offer you…

• An exciting leadership role in a growing company

• A dedicated team of passionate baristas.

• The freedom to influence the coffee shop’s development.

• Involvement in ongoing business development with leadership

• A dynamic workday with opportunities for personal and professional growth.

• Staff parties, coffee throwdowns and social runs.

• The chance to work for a certified B-Corp company.

How to apply

We look forward to hearing from you and welcoming you to Original Coffee – brewed by friends.

Please note that a valid work permit in Denmark is required, as we are unable to provide support for visa applications or related processes.

We would also like to request a reference from your former employer.

Get to know us better:

Website: originalcoffee.dk

LinkedIn: www.linkedin.com/company/originalcoffee/

Facebook: www.facebook.com/0riginalcoffee

Warranty Engineer - technical expert

At Körber Supply Chain, we are passionate about delivering innovative automation solutions that help our customers optimize their supply chains and stay competitive in a rapidly changing world. To support our continued growth, we are looking for a skilled and customer-focused Warranty Engineer who can combine technical expertise, project management, and customer engagement to ensure the successful handling and resolution of warranty-related issues across our advanced warehouse automation solutions.

Acting as the link between customers, engineering teams, suppliers, and internal stakeholders, you will play a key role in driving customer satisfaction while contributing to the continuous improvement of our products and solutions.

As our Warranty Engineer, you will be responsible for investigating and resolving technical claims related to machine performance, malfunctions, and system reliability. You will perform root cause analyses, evaluate warranty entitlement, coordinate corrective actions, and ensure timely closure of warranty cases. At the same time, you will lead warranty-related projects from initiation to completion, managing timelines, stakeholders, risks, and communication throughout the process.

Success in this role requires close collaboration across functions. You will work alongside colleagues from Engineering, Standardization, Manufacturing, and Customer Service, while also building strong relationships with customers and suppliers. Through your structured and analytical approach, you will help identify opportunities for improvement and ensure that lessons learned are translated into sustainable solutions.

We are looking for a candidate with a degree in Marine Engineering (Maskinmester), Mechanical  Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a similar technical discipline, combined with experience from technical support, warranty management, project management, or related roles within manufacturing, automation, or industrial environments. Solid technical understanding of automation systems involving PLC control systems, electrical equipment, and mechanical components in industrial machines.

We welcome applications from both recent graduates who are eager to learn and develop within the role, as well as experienced professionals who can bring valuable knowledge, insights, and expertise to the team from day one.

As a person, you are analytical, structured, and solution-oriented. You thrive in a collaborative environment and are comfortable communicating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You have a strong customer focus, take ownership of your responsibilities, and are motivated by solving complex challenges while delivering high-quality results.

At Körber Supply Chain, you will become part of an international and innovative organization where technology, collaboration, and continuous improvement are at the heart of everything we do. We offer a dynamic working environment, opportunities for professional development, and the chance to make a tangible impact on the success of our customers and business.

If you are ready to take on a role where technical expertise meets customer value and project leadership, we would love to hear from you.

Why Join Körber Supply Chain DK?

At Körber Supply Chain, we believe that our people are our greatest asset. That's why we offer a range of attractive employee benefits designed to support your well-being, development, and work-life balance.

Security & Health

In addition to a competitive salary package, you will be enrolled in our pension scheme, which includes health and dental insurance, as well as access to physiotherapy services. You will also be part of our lunch program, where our canteen serves healthy and varied meals every day.

Learning & Development

We are committed to the continuous development of our employees and offer relevant training and development opportunities. Whether your goal is to strengthen your technical expertise, leadership capabilities, or professional skills, we support your growth and long-term career development.

A Strong Community

Our culture is built on collaboration, engagement, and strong relationships. Through our active employee association and various company events, you'll have plenty of opportunities to connect with colleagues. Activities include Friday bars, Christmas parties, our annual ski trip, cultural events, and much more.

Körber – Conquer Supply Chain Complexity

At Körber, we are passionate about creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected. We celebrate diversity and welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic or social background, religion or belief, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Apply now and join our team!

Ready for your next step? Click on ‘Apply now’ to get started right away! As long as the position is advertised, you can apply at any time.

We value diversity and therefore welcome all applicants - regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic or social origin, religion/belief, disability, age, sexual orientation and identity, and any other protected status. You can find out more about our culture here Culture at Körber - it's worth taking a look!

If you have any questions or technical problems, please send us an e-mail to jobs@koerber.com. Mette Maria Holmegaard Nielsen is the responsible person for this job advertisement. We work with permanent partners and therefore ask recruitment consultants to refrain from contacting us by e-mail or telephone.

At Körber, we think long term and pursue objectives that apply across all of our business areas. In line with our vision of “Market Leadership through Technology Leadership,” we have defined our “Life 2035” goals for the next decade to ensure that Körber becomes the leading partner in our industries—Life Science, Supply Chain, and High-Tech Manufacturing—by 2035.Life 2035 is built on four pillars that define how we embrace our shaping role: Leadership, Innovation, Findependence, and Empowerment. Sustainably profitable growth and financial independence form the foundation for achieving our ambitious financial targets for the next decade. By 2035, we aim to achieve global revenues of €10 billion. You can find more at https://www.koerber.com/en/about-us/what-drives-us

Körber is a global technology company for intelligent manufacturing and supply chain solutions. As a reliable innovation partner, Körber turns entrepreneurial thinking into customer success by providing leading technology to fuel what’s next – from end-to-end pharma production and advanced supply chain solutions to high-tech machinery and process equipment. Körber combines deep domain expertise with integrated hardware, software, and digital services, to help customers take the next step.

Do you want to work close to clients and help build one of Denmark’s best Business Central partners?

Kolding harbour with a tall ship, warehouses and reflections in the water — a few metres from DynaFlow’s offices

Our offices sit a few metres from the waterfront in Kolding.

At DynaFlow we are looking for an experienced Senior Business Central Consultant to join a team that knows the Business Central market from the inside. We bring many years of experience from larger consultancies, where we have led teams, built business and delivered complex client projects — and we use that experience to create confidence, clarity and solutions that hold up in practice.

About DynaFlow

At DynaFlow we believe in a different way of being a consultancy. Good advice does not start with technology, PowerPoints or processes — it starts with people, business and understanding.

We specialise in Dynamics NAV and Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central and have gathered more than 50 years of combined experience with solutions across industries, countries and organisations. Our clients range from large international groups to small and medium-sized businesses. For us, quality matters more than quantity, and we never leave a client stranded on the quayside.

About the role

As a Senior Business Central Consultant you take a central role in our work with clients. You become a trusted advisor and a strong professional sparring partner — close to the business and close to the people behind it.

You will work with advisory, solution design, implementation, support, optimisation and project management. Some tasks are about creating structure and momentum in complex ERP landscapes. Others are about making everyday work run more smoothly for the client. What they all have in common is that the solution has to make sense both now and in the longer term.

Your tasks will include:

• Analysing and mapping clients’ business processes

• Advising on the best possible use of Business Central

• Implementing, upgrading and developing Business Central solutions

• Operations, support, troubleshooting and ongoing sparring

• Project management and coordination across business, internal resources and vendors

• Close client relationships with a focus on presence and continuity

We imagine that you

• Have solid experience with Business Central/NAV, ideally at least 5 years

• Have strong business understanding from implementation, operations or advisory

• Can create clarity in complex solutions and turn needs into practical results

• Take independent ownership of clients, tasks and momentum

• Communicate clearly with management, key users, developers and partners alike

• Want to work closely with clients and build long-term relationships

• Thrive with freedom under responsibility, and bring humour and team spirit

• Speak and write fluent Danish, and preferably English

What we offer

• An important role in an ambitious, growing Business Central company

• The chance to help build one of the strongest Business Central environments in the country

• Plenty of freedom, flexibility and responsibility day to day

• Client relationships where presence and continuity actually matter

• Work for both international groups and small/medium-sized businesses

• Skilled colleagues with deep consulting and business experience

• The option to work from home and flexible working hours

• Canteen lunch scheme

• Pension with a health-insurance scheme

• Paid phone and internet

• Premium offices a few metres from the waterfront in Kolding

How to apply

Send your application and CV to kontakt@dynaflow.dk. We invite candidates to interviews on a rolling basis, so don’t hesitate to reach out.

If you have questions about the position, you are very welcome to call Chris or Rasmus. We look forward to hearing from you.

Chris Erik Jensen

+45 36 20 70 13cej@dynaflow.dk

Rasmus Torpe

+45 30 23 14 47rto@dynaflow.dk

Senior Full Stack SDET

On-site

• Hørsholm, Sjælland, Denmark

• 
R&D

Job description

Trackman is the leading brand in its field, trusted by elite athletes worldwide. We’re growing and looking for a Senior Full Stack SDET who is passionate about quality engineering and excited to help test and improve world-class sports technology products.

This senior, full-stack quality engineering role spans backend API testing and frontend (Windows and web) application testing. You’ll combine strong automation skills with the ability to define end-to-end quality strategies across the Trackman ecosystem—from radar data pipelines to TM Performance Studio used by athletes and coaches worldwide.

You’ll join an international team and help elevate quality practices by mentoring peers, partnering closely with developers, product owners, and UI/UX designers, and championing a quality-first approach throughout the development lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Design, build, and maintain robust test automation frameworks for both backend APIs (REST/GraphQL), web applications and Windows desktop applications

• 
Architect end-to-end test strategies covering integration, system, performance, and regression testing

• 
Lead test planning and review sessions within Agile/Scrum ceremonies alongside developers and product owners

• 
Drive quality across the full stack: from data ingestion APIs and cloud services through to client-facing Windows/Web applications

• 
Define and enforce test coverage standards, reporting metrics, and quality gates within CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps)

• 
Explore and implement AI-assisted testing techniques — including AI-generated test cases, intelligent test prioritisation, and anomaly detection — to increase testing efficiency and coverage

• 
Mentor and guide junior QA engineers and SDETs across the team

• 
Collaborate with DevOps and platform engineers to embed testing earlier in the development pipeline (shift-left)

• 
Participate in design reviews and contribute to technical architecture discussions from a testability perspective

• 
Conduct exploratory and risk-based testing to uncover edge cases beyond automated suites

Job requirements

The Ideal Candidate

• 
Holds a relevant degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent (bachelor's level minimum)

• 
Has 5+ years of experience in quality engineering or SDET roles, with proven seniority in at least two of: backend API testing, desktop/Windows application testing, or test framework architecture

• 
Is highly proficient in C# for test automation, with strong understanding of object-oriented design principles.

• 
Has hands-on experience with API testing tools and frameworks (e.g., RestEaze, Postman, Playwright, SpecFlow, or similar)

• 
Has experience testing Windows/Web based applications and understands UI automation frameworks

• 
Is experienced with Azure DevOps or equivalent CI/CD platforms for pipeline integration and test reporting

• 
Demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an ability to diagnose complex, cross-layer defects

AI & Emerging Technologies

• Has experience with and understands how AI and machine learning concepts can be applied within a quality engineering context

It Will Also Be a Plus If You Have

• 
Experience in the gaming or sports technology industry

• 
Knowledge of radar, computer vision, or sensor data systems

• 
Golf knowledge or broader sports interest — you don't need to be a pro, but a genuine passion for sports helps!

We Offer

• 
A senior, high-impact role in which you will directly shape Trackman's quality engineering culture and practices

• 
The chance to work with and test the world's leading sports tracking technology, trusted by elite athletes across golf, baseball, and football

• 
A collaborative, cross-functional team with 40+ highly skilled colleagues from more than 35 nationalities

• 
Exposure to cutting-edge technology — radar, computer vision, real-time data, and AI — in a unique product domain

• 
An open, informal, and ambitious company culture where great ideas are heard and innovation is encouraged

• 
Continuous learning and growth opportunities as Trackman scales

• 
Social activities and a vibrant team culture

The Office

We are located at DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We take great pride in the state-of-art building we have designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness center, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff.

Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology

Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.

We are a Danish company founded, owned, and managed since 2003 by three entrepreneurs with a strong passion for sports. Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. We employ over 1000+ people worldwide, half of which work in Denmark, where most hardware and software products are developed, tested, and manufactured.

Where innovation happens

At Trackman, we know that great people make great products. We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. This mix makes Trackman an inspiring company – for our customers and colleagues.

Share our Passion!

Applications are continuously assessed, so please send your application as soon as possible.

Job Description

Do you want to be a part of the development of our new e-commerce platform with more than 3.600 stores and 29 web shops? Or some of our more than 80 other java applications? In that case, come and join our Java department.

JYSK is a frontrunner in the development of online cross channel E-commerce. And with Unified Commerce, JYSK has launched its biggest IT initiative ever,

We are looking for a Student Software Engineer to join our Java Core team. In this role, you will not only support building applications - you will also support our Java developers across all agile teams.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

We are in the middle of restructuring our IT landscape, turning it into a headless, event driven and microservice architecture. You will have a unique opportunity to build deep technical competencies while making a tangible difference for your colleagues.

Furthermore, we offer you:

• 
A student position averaging approximately 15 hours per week, with flexibility around your studies because we believe your education comes first

• 
A relaxed and open-minded atmosphere

• 
Sparring and feedback from skilled colleagues at all levels in the organisation

• 
A job with rich possibilities to influence the demanding technical solutions

• 
A corporate culture with a short distance from thought to action

• 
A job where you get the opportunity to develop professionally and personally

WHAT YOUR NEXT JOB WILL BE ABOUT

As a Student Software Engineer in the Java Core team, your mission is to create hyper-productivity through AI enablement while simultaneously raising the quality, security, and consistency across teams and codebases. You will help identify opportunities to leverage AI in software development and contribute to building scalable tools and solutions that enable developers to work more efficiently and deliver high-quality software.

Your tasks and responsibilities will include:

• 
Supporting Java developers across all agile teams with cross-cutting tooling, standards, and best practices

• 
Exploring and implementing new ways to leverage AI, including GitHub Copilot and other AI-powered developer tools, to improve engineering productivity, code quality, and the overall developer experience

• 
Taking ownership of smaller applications and general shared libraries used across the organisation

• 
Working with modern technologies and frameworks, including Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, and Kubernetes/Docker.

The Java team is responsible for a wide range of in-house developed applications. So, you will get the opportunity to work in different business areas and with different technologies.

You can read more about our department here.

WHAT SHOULD YOU BRING

We are looking for a new colleague who:

• 
Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, with plans to continue into a Master's degree. Ideally, you are in the final stage of your Bachelor’s degree or have recently completed it.

• 
Has hands-on experience with software development through university, personal or hobby projects.

• 
Is passionate about software engineering and enjoys building tools that solve real problems.

• 
Is motivated to become a highly skilled software engineer and continuously strives to improve their technical and professional skills

• 
Writes clean, secure code and has a strong focus on quality and consistency

• 
Values testing and writes thorough unit and integration tests to ensure reliable software (familiarity with Test-Driven Development is a plus)

• 
Is curious about emerging technologies, engineering productivity, and AI-assisted development

• 
Enjoys learning and experimenting with innovative approaches

Additional Information

IS THIS YOUR NEXT OPPORTUNITY? Apply today!

If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact Liliana Hajek, leh@jysk.com

We kindly ask you to only attach your CV. With us, there is no need to write a traditional cover letter when applying for a job.

Instead, when you click “I’m interested/Apply”, you will have the option to write a brief message to the hiring team. If you wish, you can use this space to share your motivation for applying or highlight anything else you feel is relevant.

ABOUT US

We believe our employees are key to our success. That is why we strive to offer development and possibilities of growing and finding new challenges within JYSK. Since our founder, Lars Larsen, opened his first store in Denmark in 1979, JYSK has expanded our global presence with stores and web shops in countries around the world.

Our three fundamental JYSK Values – Tradesman, Colleague and Corporate Spirit – express the behaviour and attitude that we can expect from each other. We trust each other, and we believe in Empowerment and freedom with responsibility. We also take pride in rewarding engagement and a great effort among our employees. With the right attitude, opportunities abound in JYSK.

JYSK wants to include everyone, no matter the age, gender identity, race, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, ethnicity, and experience. Together, we secure our inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. Because a great mix of minds, talents and unique personalities makes us a stronger team.

For more information, please visit our career page.

Head of Real Estate

• Full-time

Company Description

Are you ready to take on one of the most ambitious challenges within Corporate Real Estate Management? Do you have the leadership skills, technical insight, and international mindset needed to drive the implementation of JYSK’s Smart Store initiative across 29 countries?

As Head of Real Estate you will play a key role in shaping how JYSK works with building automation, energy management, and operational excellence across our store portfolio. Based at our Head Office in Aarhus, you will establish and develop a newly created function while leading initiatives that support JYSK’s continued growth and expansion.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

This is a unique opportunity to build and lead a new Centre of Excellence within JYSK Real Estate. You will join an international and informal environment characterised by strong teamwork, short decision-making processes, and a high level of responsibility. Reporting to the Expansion Director, Real Estate, you will work closely with colleagues across countries and functions while leading the most ambitious project in JYSK Real Estate ever, the Smart Stores Initiative.

Furthermore, we offer you:

• A unique opportunity to establish and develop a new function with high visibility across the organisation

• A key role in delivering the Smart Store initiative across JYSK’s international store network

• Professional and personal development in a growing international retail company

• A dedicated and experienced leadership team that values collaboration and knowledge sharing

• A modern workplace at our Head Office in Aarhus

• Attractive staff benefits and special discounts within the Lars Larsen Group

• Internal training and development opportunities to support your continued growth

WHAT YOUR NEXT JOB WILL BE ABOUT

In this role, you will be responsible for transforming strategic ambitions into operational standards and scalable solutions. You will lead the development of JYSK’s Centre of Excellence within Real Estate and ensure that building automation, energy management, and Smart Store technologies are implemented consistently across countries.

The position includes approximately 4-6 travel days per month and involves close collaboration with stakeholders throughout the organisation.

Your tasks and responsibilities in the job include:

• Establishing and leading the Real Estate Center of Excellence

• Driving the implementation and continuous development of the Smart Store initiative across 29 countries

• Defining and maintaining standards, guidelines, and execution models for building solutions

• Leading initiatives within energy management and building automation to improve operational performance

• Supporting ISO-related processes and ensuring alignment between strategy and operational execution

• Acting as a member of the Real Estate Leadership Team and contributing to strategic decision-making

• Providing leadership and professional guidance to both Head Office teams and matrix stakeholders across countries

WHAT SHOULD YOU BRING

You are an experienced leader who can combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You are comfortable working in an international environment and know how to create alignment across multiple stakeholders. At the same time, you bring strong technical knowledge and a structured approach to implementing complex solutions.

Ideally, we are looking for a new colleague who:

• Has more than 10 years of relevant professional experience, preferably from an international organisation

• Holds an engineering degree or a similar technical qualification within Electrical Engineering, HVAC, Building Automation, or a related discipline

• Has extensive experience with building automation systems, energy management, and technical building solutions

• Has strong project management capabilities and a track record of delivering complex international projects

• Understands operational excellence, ISO standards, and the conversion of strategy into measurable actions

• Is an engaging leader who can develop teams and build strong relationships across functions and countries

• Has experience working with energy management systems, building management systems, and standard business applications

Additional Information

If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact Expansion Director Real Estate, Søren Prahl at +45 28 92 29 78.

CABIN CREW SAS

City:  Kastrup

Cabin Crew Opportunities at SAS

Join SAS Cabin Crew – Opportunities Across Scandinavia

SAS is expanding—connecting people, cultures, and destinations like never before, and we invite you to be part of the journey.

We are now recruiting Cabin Crew - Air Hosts/ Hostesses on different base locations across Scandinavia and also Air Stewards in Copenhagen.

• Copenhagen

• Stockholm

• Oslo

• Bergen

By joining SAS, you will become part of a passionate team dedicated to safety, service, and creating memorable travel experiences for our customers every day.

As Cabin Crew at SAS, you will meet people from all around the world while ensuring onboard safety, delivering excellent service, and representing one of Scandinavia’s leading airlines. Our Air Steward opportunities also include additional responsibilities connected to onboard dining and premium service delivery for candidates with strong hospitality and food & beverage backgrounds.

Whether you already have Cabin Crew experience or are looking for a new career beyond the ordinary, this is your opportunity to take off with SAS.

Minimum Requirements

To apply, you must:

• Be at least 18 years old ( 20 years old for Norway base location)

• Have completed high school education or equivalent

• Be between 160 cm and 190 cm tall (without shoes)

• Have a minimum of 2 years’ experience in a customer-facing role

• Be fluent in English, both spoken and written

• Have strong swimming skills

• Hold a valid EU passport allowing free travel worldwide

• Be able to work irregular hours, including weekends and public holidays

• Meet local residency and commuting requirements for your selected base location

• Be able to comply with SAS uniform regulations

The successful candidate

Experience from hospitality, sales, food & beverage service, restaurants, hotels, catering, or events is considered an advantage.

For some specialist onboard service opportunities, candidates with hospitality, culinary, wine, or premium service backgrounds may be especially relevant.

Previous Cabin Crew experience is considered an advantage but is not required for all positions.

Additional requirements for experienced Cabin Crew:

• Valid EASA Attestation and Medical

• Minimum one year of continuous experience as Senior Cabin Crew within the past five years

Security & Medical Requirements

• Employment requires an approved Security Assessment, including a security interview, 5-year background check, reference checks, and an exhaustive police certificate/clean record.

• Successful completion of the training course and meeting all company requirements for Cabin Crew employment.

• Good physical and mental health, as well as good vision (+/- 0.7 with or without correction). Candidates must be able to obtain medical approval according to EASA regulations. To read more about medical certification for Cabin Crew, click here: www.trafikstyrelsen.dk/arbejdsomraader/luftfart/flyvemedicin/-for-piloter-kabinepersonale-samt-flyveledere

• Employment also requires successful completion of drug and alcohol tests (blood and urine samples).

• Our premises and work are located within airport security restricted areas; therefore, candidates must be approved by the relevant aviation authorities.

• All steps above must be successfully completed before commencing Cabin Crew training.

We are looking for candidates who are:

• Strong team players with a positive and professional attitude

• Passionate about service, food, and guest experience

• Structured, punctual, and able to stay ahead in a busy environment

• Calm under pressure with strong problem-solving skills

• Comfortable taking responsibility and guiding others when needed

Our Culture at SAS

At Scandinavian Airlines, we focus on caring for people, delivering exceptional experiences for travelers, and advancing the transition toward more sustainable aviation. This is guided by our iCARE framework, reflecting our commitment to Inspiration, Collaboration, Accountability, Recognition, and Execution in everything we do.

As a future team member, you can expect to be part of a collaborative environment where shared goals drive performance, contributions are recognized, and successes are celebrated. We place strong emphasis on safe, sustainable, and punctual operations while actively working to reduce environmental impact and transform for the future.

Additional information

Recruitment Process

Our recruitment process includes:

• Application and online assessment

• Video introduction

• Assessment Center

• Background and security checks

• Medical examination and testing

• Cabin Crew training

Recruitment takes place based on operational needs. Upcoming training courses are planned for fall 2026 and spring 2027.

How to Apply

Please note that SAS is partnering with AAP Aviation for this recruitment process. To apply, please use the relevant application links below. Only applications submitted through these channels will be accepted.

Air Stewards Copenhagen

SAS | Air Steward | Copenhagen | 2026-2027 – AAP Aviation Job Portal

Air Host/Hostess Stockholm

SAS | Cabin Crew | Stockholm | 2026-2027 – AAP Aviation Job Portal

Air Host/Hostess Copenhagen

SAS | Cabin Crew | Copenhagen | 2026-2027 – AAP Aviation Job Portal

Air Host/Hostess in Oslo

SAS | Cabin Crew | Oslo | 2026-2027 – AAP Aviation Job Portal

Due to the high number of applications, response times may be longer than usual. If you have not received a rejection, your application may still be under review.

If you have questions regarding the recruitment process, you are welcome to contact: cc@aapaviation.com

Looking forward to meeting you - come and fly with us!

SAS, Scandinavia's leading airline since 1946, operates from its principal hub at Copenhagen Airport (CPH), complemented by hubs in Oslo (OSL) and Stockholm (ARN). Our mission is to connect Scandinavia with the world and the world with Scandinavia. Each year, SAS serves more than 25 million passengers and transports 55 tons of cargo to 135 destinations across Europe, the USA, and Asia. With a passionate workforce of over 10,000 colleagues, we collaborate with partners and customers to drive transformative changes in aviation. We are seeking skilled and motivated Deck Officers to join our modern fleet of Trailing Suction Hopper Dredgers operating on projects worldwide.

You will become part of an international team where collaboration, innovation, and continuous development are highly valued.

• Hold a valid Certificate of Competency as Master or Chief Mate, at least up to 3,000 GT

• Possess all required and valid STCW certifications

• Have strong English communication skills, both written and spoken, corresponding to a minimum B2 level (CEFR)

• Demonstrate professionalism and sound decision-making abilities

NORTH is looking for talented students with business backgrounds who aspire towards a career within management consulting. As a Business Analyst, you will get the chance to work directly with our clients on diverse strategy and technology projects with a focus on sales and service operations.

Your responsibilities

As a Business Analyst, you’ll work as part of a team of problem solvers with extensive consulting experience, helping our clients solve their complex business issues from strategy to execution. Together with your team, you will be engaged in commercial transformation projects for a variety of clients, where you will act as an advisor in building solutions for business challenges in a sales and/or service context. You will typically be involved in all project phases, focusing on understanding business objectives and identifying possible solutions, which will rely heavily on technology, e.g., a Salesforce implementation or another CRM platform. Your responsibilities will be:

• 
Assisting in designing winning commercial strategies and delivering commercial excellence projects

• 
Conducting qualitative and quantitative analyses to identify, understand, and address client challenges

• 
Effectively visualising and communicating complex analyses to client

• 
Performing analyses of commercial processes in sales and service functions to define one global operating model

Your skills and experience

To succeed in the role, you have strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Preferably, you have knowledge or experience with strategic management, commercial excellence, or sales- and service processes. As a person, you have a high level of drive and like to have a responsibility, where you continuously seek to improve the quality of your work. You are curious, learn to dare, and are comfortable in teams with an empathic mindset. You have the following skills and experience:

• 
You are studying for a bachelor’s or master’s degree in business and have demonstrated a strong academic performance

• 
You have student job or internship experience from a consulting company or commercial experience from a C25 company

• 
You have a strong commercial mindset, seeking to improve sales and profitability

• 
You have an interest in working in the field between business and technology

• 
You can communicate complex problems and solutions in a simple understandable way, both verbally, in writing, and visually

• 
You have strong interpersonal skills and the ability to engage with stakeholders at all levels

• 
You have excellent language skills in English

We expect you to be flexible and co-operative and can work independently under changing conditions. You should be able to work 2-3 days a week, however, we also understand that you must attend to and prioritise your studies, and we are aware that there will be times when assignments and exams occupy you. Furthermore, it’s possible to work full-time for a short or long period of time for example in between semesters.

What we offer you

We offer a challenging, dynamic, and welcoming environment, where you will get the opportunity to work with global transformation projects. You will get excellent development opportunities among highly competent and ambitious colleagues and leaders as well as regular mentoring and feedback to support your rapid development. You will work with a high degree of freedom and extensive responsibility while getting support from your team in an effort to become better at helping our clients create exceptional results continually.

You will get a unique opportunity to influence projects and your position in a rapidly developing environment. Last but not least, you will join a culture with a family vibe, a down-to-earth spirit, and a social gathering agenda.

How you apply

Please submit your motivational letter, CV, and university transcripts from your bachelor’s and master’s degrees. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and interviews are arranged selectively.

To apply for this role, you must hold a valid work permit that allows for employment in Denmark and permits international travel on par with EU/EFTA citizenship rights.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Sofie Hummer

Sofie comes with a background in Finance and Strategic Management from Copenhagen Business School.

DESIGN OF INTELIGENT HYDRAULIC SYSTEMS FOR CUSTOMIZED BRAKING APPLICATIONS

Vejstrup

Can you see yourself working in a well-established Application & Control department with competent and motivated colleagues? Can you envision yourself designing solutions that create safety and security in every type of braking application where large forces or special conditions apply?

Then you might be the next engineer to join the team at Svendborg Brakes.

Develop innovative brake solutions for demanding applications

Together with your competent colleagues in the Application & Control Department, you will be involved in projects related to customer-specific applications. These applications must function in environments such as underwater turbines, submarines, elevators, or at high altitudes in the mountains of Tibet. The applications are diverse and offer plenty of design challenges.

Based on specifications and timelines, projects are led by a Project Manager. This allows you to focus on the technical aspects of the projects as well as managing your own project timeline. Your tasks will include:

• 
Technical adjustments of the core product and components for braking systems

• 
Design and construction of braking systems and components, including hydraulic systems

• 
Leading and ensuring the execution of testing these designs in the test center and production facilities

• 
Preparing technical documentation, including drawings and bills of materials (BOMs)

• 
Participation in development projects, including new material types and customer-specific projects.

Your typical workday will be a mix of independent work and a cross-functional collaboration, as solutions are often found through interdisciplinary collaboration. Among other things, you will work closely with a technical designer who supports you by creating technical documentation.

Svendborg Brakes has its own hydraulic manufacturing and test center, where designs can be tested and where customers visit to follow the project progress. This means you will be able to see your projects through from start to finish.

You are passionate about engineering and intelligent hydraulic systems

We are looking for an engineer with a strong passion for engineering and hydraulics. You have both an interest in and experience with mechanical design, hydraulics, and electrical control systems, and you are motivated by continuously developing your skills. You most likely hold a degree in mechatronics or mechanical engineering and have at least three years of professional experience.

You take a structured approach to your work and maintain a strong overview of tasks and processes. You understand that respecting specifications and timelines leads to the best results and strongest collaboration. You communicate effectively with people from different professional backgrounds and interact effortlessly with both customers and colleagues across departments.

In addition, you are fully comfortable communicating in English, both verbally and in writing.

Do you want to join the team?

At Svendborg Brakes, you will experience a flat organizational structure and an informal culture, where you have the freedom to plan your own workday and the projects you are involved in. You will also be part of a close cross-functional collaboration, where colleagues complement each other across projects with their individual areas of expertise.

Svendborg Brakes’ willingness and motivation to explore new technologies - as one of the world leaders in this field - is evident throughout the company. In other words, you will join a team with high level of expertise and a strong dedication to continuous development. This gives you a unique opportunity to develop your skills based on your interests and motivation.

Our Business Development & Portfolio Management area has an ambitious strategy and we are looking for someone with a generic-pharma mindset or experience to drive the transformation and make sure we execute according to our plans, roadmaps and business goals within the area and along the value chain

About the job

This role is best suited for someone who knows how a generic pharma business operates. Compared with an originator company, we work with a broad portfolio, lean teams and short decision paths, and value comes from pragmatic, commercially minded execution.

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

• Drive the transformation in the Business Development & Portfolio Management area from process changes to new ways of working

• Identify program impacts and design adoption measures together with functional leads

• Track adoption and take corrective action when change is not landing as planned

• Own the communication plan that keeps the organization informed and engaged

• Own the strategy execution roadmap for the Business Development & Portfolio Management area, ensuring alignment with Orifarm’s overall strategy and business goals

• Translate priorities into concrete program briefs, project charters, milestones and benefit maps

• Follow up on progress against plans and goals – with a single, transparent view of status, risks, dependencies and benefit realization

• Drive cross-functional coordination along the value chain – Portfolio, Regulatory Affairs, Business Development, Commercial and Operations – and ensure timely resolution of blockers

• Run the governance rhythm: program boards, track reviews and reporting to the Executive Management Group

You will report directly to our Chief Business Development & Portfolio Strategy Officer. You will present strategy updates and projects to our Executive Management Group and hold an explicit mandate to drive execution across the organization.

Who are you

We are looking for someone with significant experience driving transformations or programs in complex organizations, and a track record of making sure plans are executed and business goals are delivered.

Additionally, you will need to have experience from a generic or off-patent pharma business – across areas such as portfolio, business development, regulatory or commercial operations and you know how it differs from an originator company: broad portfolios, lean organizations, tight margins and pragmatic decision-making. Experience from a comparable commercial healthcare environment is also relevant.

You communicate clearly with executives, build alignment across functions, markets and cultures, and are comfortable challenging when progress stalls. You also ensure the right level of structure and governance for a regulated environment without building heavier processes than the business needs

Lastly, you have strong analytical skills, hold complexity across several concurrent workstreams and master program management methods and tools. A certification such as PRINCE2, MSP or PMI-PgMP is an advantage.

Who are we?

The Business Development & Portfolio Management area covers Portfolio Strategy, Business Development, Regulatory Affairs and Pharmacovigilance. You will partner closely with Strategy, the Strategy & PPMO Office, People & Culture and other corporate functions.

What we offer

• A role at the center of strategic decision-making, with direct access to the C-level and the Executive Management Group

• A clear mandate to drive execution across the organization

• An entrepreneurial culture that celebrates can-do attitudes, smarts and hearts, and a strong feedback culture that supports your development

• Flexibility and a strong commitment to work-life balance in an international setting with opportunities for growth

• A bonus scheme that includes every employee when we have good results

• A great canteen, massage service at our Odense office and social events throughout the year

Why should you join Orifarm?

At Orifarm, we are 2,300 employees united by a shared purpose: improving access to affordable medicine for the people who need it. Founded in Odense, Denmark in 1994 by Birgitte & Hans Bøgh-Sørensen, we have built our business on challenging conventional thinking to make affordable high-quality pharmaceuticals more accessible across Europe. Rather than developing new medicines, we focus on finding smarter ways to bring existing treatments to patients, creating value for pharmacies, healthcare systems, and society.

We live by the mindset Challenge Accepted. It reflects our explorer spirit and can-do attitude, where challenges are perceived as opportunities. We encourage people to ask questions, challenge assumptions, and take ownership. Across teams, functions, and markets, you will find a collaborative and supportive culture built on trust, respect, and a flat hierarchy where everyone has a voice and direct access to decision-makers.

When you join Orifarm, you will be empowered to make a real impact from day one. We offer autonomy and great opportunities for career advancement, enabling our employees to shape their professional development. We value flexibility and provide a hybrid work model with the possibility of working from home two days a week.

We invite you to join Orifarm, if you are curious, ambitious, and accept the challenge of bringing better deals of medicine to millions.

We encourage everyone to apply

At Orifarm, we welcome people from all backgrounds, recognizing that the best outcomes come from a diverse and inclusive work environment. Our commitment is to create an environment where different perspectives and skills drive innovation and contribute to a sustainable future. By creating such an environment, we are confident that we can achieve better results together.

Job location

Odense, Denmark. You will work from our Odense office 2–3 days a week to be close to the majority of your stakeholders. We welcome candidates based outside Denmark who can commit to this whether by commuting or relocating (relocation support and expenses will be covered by Orifarm).

Application deadline

As soon as possible.

Your impact begins here

As Process Cleaning Engineer, you will help establish a brand-new API purification facility by making sure its process equipment can be cleaned reliably and in line with GMP. You will take cleaning from design through commissioning, qualification and validation, working closely with engineering, automation, validation and manufacturing colleagues. Your work helps build production capacity that is flexible and ready for future growth, supporting people living with serious chronic diseases around the world.

What you’ll bring

• A bachelor’s degree or higher in Engineering, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Biotechnology, Chemistry or a related discipline.

• Experience working in a GMP-regulated environment, preferably in pharmaceutical, biotech or API manufacturing.

• Knowledge of pharmaceutical production processes, process equipment, validation activities and GMP documentation practices.

• Professional proficiency in written and spoken English.

• The ability to collaborate across disciplines, work through technical challenges and take ownership in a regulated, project-driven environment.

We are hiring several Process Cleaning Engineers and welcome applications from people with different levels of experience. What matters most is how you collaborate, solve problems and deliver quality.

Useful, but not essential:

• Experience with Cleaning-in-Place (CIP), cleaning validation, qualification activities or process engineering.

• Danish language skills.

What you’ll do

You will be part of a major expansion project, helping design, develop, validate and implement cleaning processes that meet both regulatory requirements and day-to-day operational needs.

• Drive Cleaning-in-Place (CIP) activities across the project lifecycle, from design and commissioning through qualification and validation.

• Take part in design reviews, risk assessments, engineering runs, riboflavin testing, verification activities and troubleshooting.

• Support validation activities and make sure work meets GMP requirements and internal quality standards.

• Work with contractors, engineering partners, project teams and manufacturing representatives to keep decisions clear and work moving.

• Contribute to risk management and continuous improvement, and help shape future standards for cleaning processes in API manufacturing.

Who you’ll work with

You will join PS API Expansions, part of API Manufacturing in Global Manufacturing & Supply. The team designs, plans and delivers major API capacity expansion projects across Novo, building flexible, future-ready production facilities for the people who need our treatments.

Your closest partners will be engineering, automation and validation specialists, along with project teams, contractors and manufacturing colleagues, both internal and external. The team works across disciplines, functions and geographies, and shares knowledge to keep these strategic projects on track.

You will report to Manager Guilherme Sales or Allan Feldtskov, who can tell you more about the team and the role.

What you can expect here

You will be trusted to influence technical decisions and contribute to the successful delivery of a facility that supports Novo’s future growth. You will work with state-of-the-art technologies and ambitious sustainability targets, and build new skills through hands-on experience in a large-scale pharmaceutical project.

You will be supported to perform at your best in a team where knowledge sharing and continuous learning are part of daily work, and where your voice is heard.

What we offer

At Novo, you’ll join a global healthcare company with a unique culture and strong results. We offer continuous learning, career development, and benefits tailored to your life and career stage.

Salary:  For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 570,200 DK to 838,100 DKK corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

Start now

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to help build a facility that will support people living with serious chronic diseases, apply for the Process Cleaning Engineer role by 8th of November 2026.

For further information about the position, please contact Manager Allan Feldtskov at +45-30750679.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

At Novo Nordisk, we're not chasing quick fixes – we're creating lasting change for long-term health. For over 100 years, we've been driven by a single purpose: to defeat serious chronic diseases and help millions of people live healthier lives. This dedication fuels our constant curiosity and inspires us to push the boundaries of what's possible in healthcare. We embrace diverse perspectives, seek out bold ideas, and build partnerships rooted in shared purpose. Together, we're making healthcare more accessible, treating and preventing diseases, and pioneering solutions that create change spanning generations. When you join us, you become part of something bigger – a legacy of impact that reaches far beyond today.

jobs.occupation: Supply Chain Internship Roster 2026 – Supply Chain Management Unit (SCMU), Copenhagen, Denmark
jobs.description:
The Position:

The UNFPA Supply Chain Management Unit (SCMU) is seeking candidates for its newly established Supply Chain Internship Roster 2026. These internship opportunities are on-site at SCMU’s office in the UN City headquarters in Copenhagen, Denmark.

SCMU offers specialized functional streams aligned with its operational needs, including:

• Data & Analytics

• Logistics & Supply Chain

• Procurement & Business

• Humanitarian Supplies

• Supply Chain & Customer Service

• Governance, Risk & Compliance

• Communications

• Human Resources

• Information and Communications Technology (ICT)

• Administration & Business

To ensure effective team integration and maximize the value of the internship, candidates must be logistically and financially prepared to undertake full-time, on-site work in Copenhagen for the duration of the internship.

How you can make a difference:

UNFPA is the lead UN agency for delivering a world where every pregnancy is wanted, every childbirth is safe and every young person's potential is fulfilled.  UNFPA’s strategic plan (2026-2029), reaffirms the relevance of the current strategic direction of UNFPA and focuses on three transformative results: to end preventable maternal deaths; end unmet need for family planning; and end gender-based violence and harmful practices. These results capture our strategic commitments on accelerating progress towards realizing the ICPD and SDGs in the Decade of Action leading up to 2030. Our strategic plan calls upon UN Member States, organizations and individuals to “build forward better”, while addressing the negative impacts of the Covid-19 pandemic on women’s and girls’ access to sexual and reproductive health and reproductive rights, recover lost gains and realize our goals.

The UNFPA Supply Chain Management Unit (SCMU) is self-funded and was made operational in January 2022. It is tasked with ensuring that UNFPA is able to effectively and efficiently support the delivery of life-saving reproductive health products and other programme supplies to the end user when and where they are needed. To achieve this, it is important to strengthen the capacity of governments and implementing partners to ensure coordination, end-to-end visibility and accountability on all supply chain and logistics management related activities, in particular for programme supplies, across all UNFPA programmes.

In a world where fundamental human rights are at risk, we need principled and ethical staff, who embody these international norms and standards, and who will defend them courageously and with full conviction.

UNFPA is seeking candidates that transform, inspire and deliver high impact and sustained results; we need staff who are transparent, exceptional in how they manage the resources entrusted to them and who commit to deliver excellence in programme results.

Eligibility:

Educational requirements

a. Be enrolled in a first university degree programme (such as bachelor’s degree or equivalent) and have completed one full academic year;

b. Be enrolled in a postgraduate degree programme (such as master’s programme or higher);

c. Have recently graduated with a university degree as defined above and, if selected, must start the internship within one-year of graduation; or

d. Be enrolled in a postgraduate professional trainee programme and undertake the internship as part of this programme.

Other eligibility requirements

e. Demonstrate interest in the field of development;

f.  Demonstrate written and spoken proficiency in at least one of the working languages of the United Nations (English or French) and fluency in the official language (Arabic, Chinese, English, French, Russian or Spanish) of the UNFPA office; and

g. Demonstrate ability to adapt to new environments and to establish and maintain good working relations with individuals of different cultural backgrounds.

An individual whose father, mother, son, daughter, brother or sister is a UNFPA staff member is not eligible for an internship with UNFPA.

Required Competencies:

Values:

• Exemplifying integrity,

• Demonstrating commitment to UNFPA and the UN system,

• Embracing cultural diversity,

• Embracing change

Core Competencies:

• Achieving results,

• Being accountable,

• Developing and applying professional expertise/business acumen,

• Thinking analytically and strategically,

• Working in teams/managing ourselves and our relationships,

Financial Support:

Interns who do not receive financial support from an outside party (such as an academic institution, university, government) are eligible to receive a stipend as a contribution towards living expenses. The stipend is based on the intern’s agreed place of work, which may be different from the duty station of the hiring office in cases of remote arrangements. The stipend is normally paid in local currency at the end of each month.

UNFPA Work Environment:

UNFPA provides a work environment that reflects the values of gender equality, diversity, integrity and healthy work-life balance. We are committed to ensuring gender parity in the organization and therefore encourage women to apply. Individuals from the LGBTQIA+ community, minority ethnic groups, indigenous populations, persons with disabilities, and other underrepresented groups are highly encouraged to apply. Reasonable accommodation may be provided to applicants with disabilities upon request, to support their participation in the recruitment process. UNFPA promotes equal opportunities in terms of appointment, training, compensation and selection for all regardless of personal characteristics and dimensions of diversity. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion is at the heart of UNFPA's workforce - click here to learn more.

Disclaimer:

UNFPA does not charge any application, processing, training, interviewing, testing or other fee in connection with the application or recruitment process and does not concern itself with information on applicants' bank accounts.
